translations.web: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.
translations.bsb: When their rulers are thrown down from the cliffs, the people will listen to my words, for they are pleasant.
translations.kjv: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
translations.asv: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock; And they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
